Here is the full 4-week boxing S&C plan with exact dates starting today (Wednesday, Nov 18, 2026), set on a Wednesday / Friday / Monday schedule so weekends and Tuesdays/Thursdays stay open for boxing skill work and sparring.
Week 1: Acclimation (Nov 18 – Nov 23)
Wednesday, Nov 18 — Day 1: Lower Body Force & Rotational Power
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest | Coaching Cue |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Med Ball Rotational Scoop Toss | 4 × 5 / side | 90s | Drive from the back hip, snap through the core, reset each rep. |
| 2. Trap Bar Deadlift (or Squat) | 4 × 4–5 | 2–3m | Heavy, crisp bar speed. Leave 2–3 reps in the tank. |
| 3. Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat | 3 × 6 / leg | 90s | Control the descent, explode up through the front mid-foot. |
| 4. Broad Jumps (Stick Landing) | 3 × 4 | 90s | Max horizontal distance, absorb force quietly. |
| 5. Pallof Press (Anti-Rotation) | 3 × 10 / side | 60s | Ribs down, resist torso twist, 2-second hold at full extension. |
Friday, Nov 20 — Day 2: Upper Body Force, Speed & Neck
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest | Coaching Cue |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Plyo Push-Ups (or Med Ball Chest Pass) | 4 × 5 | 90s | Max intent off the floor/chest; stop before speed drops. |
| 2. Weighted Pull-Ups (or Chin-Ups) | 4 × 5 | 2m | Full dead hang to chin over bar; leave 2–3 reps in reserve. |
| 3. Landmine Single-Arm Press | 3 × 6 / side | 90s | Staggered stance, punch the weight up using hip-to-shoulder transfer. |
| 4. Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row | 3 × 8 | 90s | Retract shoulder blades hard; balances high-volume punching. |
| 5. 4-Way Neck Harness / Manual Iso | 2 × 15s / dir | 45s | Flexion, extension, left/right lateral. Controlled tension only. |
| 6. Hanging Leg Raises | 3 × 10 | 60s | Curl pelvis up without swinging. |
Monday, Nov 23 — Day 3: Conditioning (4 Rounds)
 * Warm-up: 5 mins jump rope + dynamic mobility.
 * Main Block (Assault Bike, Concept2 Rower, or Sprints):
   * 10s max sprint (100% effort) + 50s active recovery × 3 = 1 round (3 mins).
   * Rest 1 minute between rounds. Complete 4 rounds.
Week 2: Load Progression (Nov 25 – Nov 30)
Wednesday, Nov 25 — Day 1: Lower Body Force & Rotational Power
 * Same exercises, sets, and reps as Week 1.
 * Adjustment: Add 2.5–5 kg to Trap Bar Deadlift (and Split Squats if crisp). Leave 2 reps in reserve.
Friday, Nov 27 — Day 2: Upper Body Force, Speed & Neck
 * Same exercises, sets, and reps as Week 1.
 * Adjustment: Add 2.5–5 kg to Weighted Pull-Ups and Landmine Press.
Monday, Nov 30 — Day 3: Conditioning (5 Rounds)
 * Same 3-minute round protocol (10s sprint / 50s recovery × 3, 1 min rest).
 * Adjustment: Increase volume to 5 rounds.
Week 3: Peak Intensity (Dec 2 – Dec 7)
Wednesday, Dec 2 — Day 1: Lower Body Force & Rotational Power
 * Same exercises, sets, and reps as Week 1.
 * Adjustment: Heaviest working weights on Trap Bar Deadlift and Split Squats (1–2 reps in reserve). Max velocity on Med Ball Toss and Broad Jumps.
Friday, Dec 4 — Day 2: Upper Body Force, Speed & Neck
 * Same exercises, sets, and reps as Week 1.
 * Adjustment: Heaviest working weights on Pull-Ups, Landmine Press, and Rows. Explosive intent on Plyo Push-Ups.
Monday, Dec 7 — Day 3: Conditioning (6 Rounds)
 * Same 3-minute round protocol (10s sprint / 50s recovery × 3, 1 min rest).
 * Adjustment: Peak volume at 6 rounds.
Week 4: Deload & Taper (Dec 9 – Dec 14)
Wednesday, Dec 9 — Day 1: Lower Body Force & Rotational Power
 * Adjustment: Cut 1 set from every exercise (e.g., 4 sets → 3 sets; 3 sets → 2 sets) and drop lift weights by 15%. Focus on fast, crisp reps.
Friday, Dec 11 — Day 2: Upper Body Force, Speed & Neck
 * Adjustment: Cut 1 set from every exercise and drop lift weights by 15%. Keep neck work light (1 × 15s / direction).
Monday, Dec 14 — Day 3: Conditioning (3 Rounds)
 * Same 3-minute round protocol (10s sprint / 50s recovery × 3, 1 min rest).
 * Adjustment: Taper volume down to 3 sharp rounds so you finish the block fresh and springy.
